description: In-world broom pickups and the World Map overlay. Add broom-pickup positions + the shared CODEX_POSITION to layout.ts, extract the shared BroomModel mesh, add BroomPickup world entities wired to collectBroom (FEAT-002), add a rebindable 'map' action (default M), a 'map' overlay plus player x/z/facing in the HUD snapshot, open-from-M wiring, pure map projection + shared quest-marker helpers (with the HUD compass refactored to share them), and the WorldMap SVG panel. Depends on FEAT-002 (collectBroom, broomsCollected, BROOM_PICKUPS used by the save sanitizer). Grounded in design.md §7 and design-review.md focus questions 1, 3, 5 and the Verified Assumptions.
steps: In src/game/world/layout.ts add: interface BroomPickupDef { id: string; name: string; position: Vec3Tuple }; export const BROOM_PICKUPS with broom-courtyard (name 'Training Broom', position ~[18,0,36] near the Practice Grounds — the early reachable soft-lock guard) and broom-platform (name 'Swiftwood Broom', position [-56, FLIGHT_PLATFORM.height, 24]); and export const CODEX_POSITION: Vec3Tuple = [-43.3, LIBRARY_BALCONY_Y + 1.05, -40.2] (exactly the literal WorldItems.Codex uses).

Create src/game/world/BroomModel.tsx by moving the local BroomModel component out of PlayerAvatar.tsx (same geometry/materials, pure presentational), and import it in PlayerAvatar.tsx from the new module (removing the local definition) to avoid an import cycle.

In src/game/world/WorldItems.tsx add a BroomPickup({ id, name, position }) component modelled on Codex/ShrineEmber: collected = useProgression(s => s.progression.broomsCollected.includes(id)); when not collected, register via registerInteractable({ id, position (Y resolved with terrainHeight(x,z) for the ground broom, FLIGHT_PLATFORM.height for the platform broom), radius ~2.5, verb 'Take', label: name, onInteract: () => useProgression.getState().collectBroom(id) }) and render a bobbing <BroomModel/>; return null and unregister once collected. Render BROOM_PICKUPS.map(b => <BroomPickup .../>) inside WorldItems(). Change Codex to source its position from CODEX_POSITION instead of the inline Vector3 literal.

In src/game/input/bindings.ts add 'map' to the Action string-literal union; add ACTION_META.map = { label: 'Open world map', context: 'any', group: 'Interface' }; add DEFAULT_BINDINGS.map = ['KeyM'] (KeyM is currently unbound). ACTIONS, findConflicts, settings sanitize, and SettingsPanel pick it up automatically.

In src/game/state/gameStore.ts add 'map' to the Overlay union. In src/game/state/hudStore.ts add playerX: number, playerZ: number, playerFacing: number (default 0) to the HudStore interface and to the initial state object so patch() type-checks.

In src/game/core/Systems.tsx HudSync, add playerX: runtime.player.position.x, playerZ: runtime.player.position.z, playerFacing: runtime.player.facing to the existing patch({...}) on the 10 Hz tick; leave heading: runtime.camera.yaw unchanged.

In src/App.tsx useMenuKeys: rename the local const map = { spellbook, journal, inventory } to const toggles = { spellbook: b.spellbook, journal: b.journal, inventory: b.inventory, map: b.map } as const and iterate toggles; widen the open guard so it also allows g.overlay === 'map' (so B/J/I and the map open over each other).

Create src/game/world/mapProjection.ts with MAP_VIEW = WORLD_HALF_SIZE and worldToMap(x, z, size): { mx, my } (mx = (x/(2*MAP_VIEW)+0.5)*size, my = (z/(2*MAP_VIEW)+0.5)*size; document that world +Z maps to +Y so north (-Z) is up). Create src/game/world/mapProjection.test.ts asserting center->center and the four corners map to the expected SVG corners.

Create src/game/quests/questMap.ts: interface QuestMarker { id; label; at: [number,number]; status: 'active'|'available' } and questMarkers(p: Progression): QuestMarker[]. For each quest in QUESTS: if questStatus === 'available', marker at its giver NPC (NPCS.find(n => n.id === q.giver)); if 'active', resolve the current objective by kind — talk->target NPC, spellHit->TRAINING_YARD center, collect->CODEX_POSITION, flightState->FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center, rings->next uncollected FLIGHT_RINGS entry, reach->FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center; omit completed. Factor the per-objective location into a shared resolver taking a forCompass flag so flightState resolves to null for the compass but FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center for the map.

Refactor src/ui/hud/HUD.tsx objectivePosition to use the shared questMap resolver (forCompass true), keeping it byte-identical for talk/spellHit/rings/reach/flightState and correcting only the collect marker from [-43,-40] to CODEX_POSITION. Create src/game/quests/questMap.test.ts asserting: each quest when available yields a marker at its giver; each active-objective kind yields its documented location (incl. active flightState -> FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center); and the compass yields today's values for the unchanged kinds, null for active flightState, and CODEX_POSITION for an active collect objective.

Create src/ui/menus/WorldMap.tsx: a role='dialog' panel modal with CloseButton and aria-label 'World map'. Draw the schematic by passing layout symbols through worldToMap ONLY (no numeric landmark literals copied in): LAKE/FOREST circles, PLATEAU/COURTYARD/GRAND_HALL/LIBRARY/TRAINING_YARD/BRIDGE rects, FLIGHT_PLATFORM circle, TOWERS circles (optional faint FLIGHT_RINGS/SECRETS). Plot questMarkers(progression) labelled with <title>, BROOM_PICKUPS glyphs styled available vs collected via progression.broomsCollected.includes(id), and a player triangle at worldToMap(playerX, playerZ) rotated by playerFacing — reading useHud selectors (playerX/playerZ/playerFacing) so it re-renders at most ~10 Hz, never per frame. Render {overlay === 'map' && <WorldMap />} inside overlay-backdrop in GameMenus.GameOverlays.

Add the Map control (default M) to the controls documentation if a README/controls table exists; no README was found in the worktree root, so record a finding and skip rather than inventing one if absent.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run src/game/world/mapProjection.test.ts passes (center and corner round-trips).
npx vitest run src/game/quests/questMap.test.ts passes (available givers; each active kind; compass unchanged kinds + null flightState + corrected collect).
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build pass.
Code-path trace (F3.1): pressing M calls openOverlay('map') and GameOverlays renders <WorldMap/>; M again or Esc closes it; the panel has role='dialog'.

Code-path trace (F3.2/F3.4/F3.5, NF.1): landmark shapes derive from layout symbols via worldToMap (no duplicated numeric landmark literals); broom markers come from BROOM_PICKUPS with collected styling from broomsCollected; the player triangle reads playerX/playerZ/playerFacing from the 10 Hz HUD snapshot.
Code-path trace (F2.4/F3.4): collecting a BroomPickup calls collectBroom, flips the selector so the mesh unmounts, and sets hasBroom so the flight gate (FEAT-002) now permits summoning.
verification: Trace design.md §10 traces 3, 4, 5 (pickup->flight enabled; map key+render; marker correctness).
findings: Step 1 (BROOM_PICKUPS + CODEX_POSITION in layout.ts) was already landed by FEAT-002 (its findings note this); NOT re-added. BroomModel extracted to src/game/world/BroomModel.tsx and imported by both PlayerAvatar.tsx (removed the local copy; the three.js geometry/material imports it needed were dropped from PlayerAvatar since BroomModel now owns them) and the new BroomPickup entity in WorldItems.tsx. BroomPickup registers via registerInteractable({ verb 'Take', radius 2.5 }) and calls useProgression.getState().collectBroom(id); Y resolves to FLIGHT_PLATFORM.height for 'broom-platform' and terrainHeight(x,z) otherwise, +0.6 lift, bobbing+spinning via useFrame; returns null + unregisters once broomsCollected.includes(id). Codex now sources CODEX_POSITION (was an inline Vector3 literal). bindings.ts: 'map' added to the Action union, ACTION_META.map ({ label 'Open world map', context 'any', group 'Interface' }) and DEFAULT_BINDINGS.map=['KeyM']; ACTIONS/findConflicts/settings sanitize/SettingsPanel pick it up via ACTIONS automatically (settings.ts iterates ACTIONS). gameStore Overlay union gained 'map'; hudStore gained playerX/playerZ/playerFacing (default 0) in interface + initial state; HudSync patches all three on the 10 Hz tick (heading left as camera.yaw). App.useMenuKeys: local 'map' table renamed to 'toggles' with map:b.map and the open guard widened to allow g.overlay==='map'. Pure modules: src/game/world/mapProjection.ts (MAP_VIEW=WORLD_HALF_SIZE, worldToMap(x,z,size); world +Z -> +Y so north(-Z) is up) + test (centre + 4 corners); src/game/quests/questMap.ts exports questMarkers(progression) and compassObjective(progression) backed by a shared objectiveLocation(o,p,forCompass) resolver — collect->CODEX_POSITION, spellHit->TRAINING_YARD centre, flightState-> null for compass / FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center for map, rings->next uncollected ring, reach->FLIGHT_PLATFORM.center, talk->giver/target NPC. HUD.tsx objectivePosition removed and replaced with compassObjective (collect corrected from [-43,-40] to CODEX_POSITION; other kinds unchanged); the now-unused NPCS/TRAINING_YARD/FLIGHT_PLATFORM/FLIGHT_RINGS/Progression/Point imports were pruned from HUD.tsx. WorldMap.tsx is a role='dialog' panel modal (aria-label 'World map') with Menu/Resume buttons; ALL landmark geometry derives from layout symbols via worldToMap/rectToMap/circleToMap (LAKE/FOREST circles, PLATEAU/COURTYARD/GRAND_HALL/LIBRARY/TRAINING_YARD/BRIDGE rects, FLIGHT_PLATFORM/TOWERS circles, faint FLIGHT_RINGS/SECRETS) — no numeric landmark literals copied; quest markers from questMarkers(), broom glyphs from BROOM_PICKUPS styled available vs collected via broomsCollected.includes(id), and a player triangle at worldToMap(playerX,playerZ) rotated by playerFacing reading the 10 Hz useHud selectors (never per frame). GameOverlays renders {overlay==='map' && <WorldMap/>}. Step 12 (controls doc): no README/controls table exists in the worktree root, so skipped per the step's own instruction. NOTE on MAP_VIEW: per spec MAP_VIEW=WORLD_HALF_SIZE (580), so the castle grounds occupy a small central region of the map; this follows the design literally. Verification from the worktree root: npx vitest mapProjection.test.ts + questMap.test.ts (9 pass), npm run typecheck (clean), npm run lint (exit 0; only pre-existing warnings, none in the new files), npm run build (tsc -b + vite build ok), and full npm test (11 files, 106 tests) all pass.
